items.distractor_fact: ఒక స్థానిక నివాసి తన ఇంటి థర్మామీటర్‌లో ఉదయం ఉష్ణోగ్రత {D}°C అని చెప్పాడు.
items.gloss_en: A local resident said the morning temperature on his own home thermometer was {D}°C.
items.entity_note: owner is a person's own home thermometer (person), not the first sentence's place (a neighbouring town)

items.distractor_fact: మరో వ్యాపారి తన ఖాతాలో ఆ రోజు ₹{D} నిల్వ ఉన్నట్లు తెలిపాడు.
items.gloss_en: Another trader reported that his own account held a balance of ₹{D} that day.
items.entity_note: owner is an individual trader's personal account (person), not the first sentence's organisation (another company)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక స్థానిక రైతు తన బావిలో ఉదయం నీటి మట్టం {D} మీటర్లు ఉందని చెప్పాడు.
items.gloss_en: A local farmer said the water level in his own well was {D} metres in the morning.
items.entity_note: owner is a farmer's own well (person), not the first sentence's place (a neighbouring reservoir)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక పైలట్ తన గ్లైడర్‌లో మొదటి పరిశీలనలో {D} మీటర్ల ఎత్తుకు చేరుకున్నాడు.
items.gloss_en: A pilot reached an altitude of {D} metres in his own glider at the first check.
items.entity_note: owner is a pilot's own glider (person), not the first sentence's instrument (another drone)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక క్లర్క్ తన సొంత సూట్‌కేసు బరువు డెలివరీకి ముందు {D} కిలోగ్రాములు ఉందని చెప్పాడు.
items.gloss_en: A clerk said his own suitcase weighed {D} kilograms before delivery.
items.entity_note: owner is a clerk's own suitcase (person), not the first sentence's object (another package)

items.distractor_fact: ఇదే మండలంలో ఒక పాఠశాలలో పిల్లల నమోదు సంఖ్య గత సంవత్సరం {D} ఉంది.
items.gloss_en: In this same mandal, a school's student enrollment count last year was {D}.
items.entity_note: owner is a school's enrollment (organisation), not the first sentence's place (a neighbouring village's population)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక స్థానిక మత్స్యకారుడు తన సొంత గుర్తు వద్ద నీటి మట్టం {D} సెంటీమీటర్లు ఉందని అంచనా వేశాడు.
items.gloss_en: A local fisherman estimated the water level at his own marker to be {D} centimetres.
items.entity_note: owner is a fisherman with his own unstated marker (person), not the first sentence's instrument (another gauge with its own datum)

items.distractor_fact: స్థానిక దుకాణం ఖజానాలో ఆ రోజు ₹{D} నగదు ఉంది.
items.gloss_en: The local shop's till had ₹{D} cash that day.
items.entity_note: owner is a shop's cash till (organisation), not the first sentence's person (Sita's money)

items.distractor_fact: పక్క పోస్టాఫీసు పొదుపు పథకంలో ఈ నెల ₹{D} జమ అయ్యాయి.
items.gloss_en: In the neighbouring post office savings scheme, ₹{D} was deposited this month.
items.entity_note: owner is a post office savings scheme (organisation), not the first sentence's instrument (another account)

items.distractor_fact: దుకాణదారు వ్యక్తిగత పొదుపు ఖాతాలో ఈ నెల ₹{D} జమ అయ్యాయి.
items.gloss_en: In the shopkeeper's own personal savings account, ₹{D} was deposited this month.
items.entity_note: owner is the shopkeeper's personal account (person), not the first sentence's organisation (the neighbouring shop)

items.distractor_fact: ఈ సీజన్‌లో ఒక ఆటగాడు వ్యక్తిగతంగా {D} గోల్స్ చేశాడు.
items.gloss_en: This season, one player personally scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: owner is an individual player's personal tally (person), not the first sentence's organisation (another team)

items.distractor_fact: స్థానిక వ్యాపార సంఘం ఖాతాలో ఈ నెల నికరంగా ₹{D} లాభం నమోదైంది.
items.gloss_en: In the local trade association's account, a net profit of ₹{D} was recorded this month.
items.entity_note: owner is a trade association (organisation), not the first sentence's person (another trader)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక చిన్న వర్క్‌షాప్ యజమాని ఈ వారం తన వాస్తవ ఉత్పత్తి {D} యూనిట్లు అని చెప్పాడు.
items.gloss_en: A small workshop owner said his own actual production this week was {D} units.
items.entity_note: owner is a workshop owner with his own unstated target (person), not the first sentence's organisation (the neighbouring factory)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక రైతు తన పొలంలో ఈ వర్షాకాలంలో వర్షపాతం {D} మిల్లీమీటర్లు అని కొలిచాడు.
items.gloss_en: A farmer measured rainfall of {D} millimetres on his own field this monsoon.
items.entity_note: owner is a farmer with his own unstated forecast (person), not the first sentence's place (the neighbouring district)

items.distractor_fact: గోల్ఫ్ క్లబ్ రికార్డుల ప్రకారం మరో టోర్నమెంట్‌లో పార్ {D} స్ట్రోక్‌లుగా నిర్ణయించారు.
items.gloss_en: According to golf club records, in another tournament, par was set at {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: owner is a different tournament's own par (organisation/event), not the first sentence's person (another player)

items.distractor_fact: మరో విమానయాన సంస్థ విమానం వాస్తవ రాక సమయం అర్ధరాత్రి నుండి {D} నిమిషాల తర్వాత ఉంది.
items.gloss_en: Another airline's flight had an actual arrival time of {D} minutes after midnight.
items.entity_note: owner is a different airline's flight with its own unstated schedule (organisation), not the first sentence's instrument (another train)

items.distractor_fact: పక్క స్టేడియంలో జరిగిన ఒక ఫ్రెండ్లీ మ్యాచ్‌లో ఒక జట్టు {D} గోల్స్ చేసింది.
items.gloss_en: In a friendly match held at the neighbouring stadium, a team scored {D} goals.
items.entity_note: owner is a match at a different stadium (place), not the first sentence's series (another match in this tournament, team Gamma)

items.distractor_fact: ఒక వ్యక్తి తన ఇంటి థర్మామీటర్‌లో ఆ రోజు ఉష్ణోగ్రత {D}°C ఉందని చెప్పాడు.
items.gloss_en: A person said the temperature on his own home thermometer that day was {D}°C.
items.entity_note: owner is a private individual's home thermometer (person), not the first sentence's place (a third city)

items.distractor_fact: ఇదే పర్వతంపై ఉన్న వాతావరణ కేంద్రం ఆ రోజు {D} మీటర్ల ఎత్తులో ఉంది.
items.gloss_en: A weather station on the same mountain was situated at an altitude of {D} metres that day.
items.entity_note: owner is a fixed weather station's own elevation (instrument/installation), not the first sentence's person (another mountaineer, Ravi)
